size_rationale: Medium because the cause sits one step away from the symptom, in the auth middleware shared by every /v1/users/:userId route, not in any route or controller the prompt names.
prompt: Regular users get 403 Forbidden when they GET, PATCH or DELETE /v1/users/<their own id>. Admins can still do all three on any account.

root_cause.detail: verifyCallback compares req.params.userId (a string) with user._id (an ObjectId) using !==, which is always true, so the owner exception never applies and users without rights get 403 on their own id.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth middleware > should call next with no errors if user does not have required rights but userId is in params
tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > GET /v1/users/:userId > should return 200 and the user object if data is ok
tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > DELETE /v1/users/:userId > should return 204 if data is ok
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js tests/integration/user.test.js -t 'should call next with no errors if user does not have required rights but userId is in params|should return 200 and the user object if data is ok|should return 204 if data is ok'
